subject: explicit-assist-admission-ownership

findings.behavior: Host-supplied assist caller and target evidence is admitted only for a living NPC in the same room with an alive detectable caller and an alive detectable explicitly hostile target.
findings.fallback: Reject the assist request and retain the prior target.

assumptions: The host observation producer has already resolved visibility and hostility.
runtime_impact: Adds deterministic assist target admission without generating hate or propagating native aggro.
world_state_impact: Persists selected target and latest assist audit metadata.
